input.interpretation: A saturated-tension reach with a correct-but-late terminal position cannot be fixed by control search alone; the structure must supply more moment per newton. input.weakening_observation: Rejection for clearance at radius 0.022 m, or a resolved layout that no longer contains both +z and -y tendons.
